_doc: BAN TIENG ANH cua prompts_30.json (D-027). HiDream-O1 khong hieu prompt tieng Viet: cung seed, ban tieng Viet cho anh KHONG lien quan den prompt. Ban nay dich TRUNG THANH, GIU NGUYEN SEED de so tung cap mot, va GIU NGUYEN chu de Viet Nam (pho, com tam, Ha Noi, ruong bac thang). CHUOI CHU trong anh (p16/p17/p18/p21/p22/p30) GIU NGUYEN tieng Viet co dau - day la gioi han san pham phai do, khong duoc dich di roi bao la xong.
